subject: BluePeak procurement: marketplace vendor onboarding & PO routing
messages:
From: Maria Santana <procurement@bluepeak.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Luis Sanchez <luis.sanchez@bluepeak.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding for 2027 procurement cycle - Redwood Inference

Hi Dylan,

We're starting vendor onboarding for our 2027 cloud tooling agreements and would like to onboard Redwood into BluePeak's procurement system and the major cloud marketplaces we use. Our Sourcing team needs: a completed vendor onboarding form, W9, bank details, and the preferred PO/ACH remittance instructions.

Separately, we want to list Redwood on our AWS/GCP/Azure procurement catalog. Could you confirm who on your side manages marketplace listing (AWS seller ID / Azure publisher / GCP partner)? Also any standard contract terms or procurement-side playbook you prefer for marketplace purchases (e.g., private offers, reseller addendum)?

We aim to have PO routing completed and the first purchase ready by the first week of January, so a quick turnaround on docs would be helpful. I've attached our vendor onboarding packet for completion.

Thanks,
Maria Santana
Sr. Procurement Manager
BluePeak Technologies
Attachments: BluePeak_Onboarding_Form.pdf (fillable), Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.docx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Maria Santana <procurement@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Luis Sanchez <luis.sanchez@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding for 2027 procurement cycle - Redwood Inference

Hi Maria — thanks for the note and the packet. Happy to coordinate.

Quick answers up front:
- Marketplace owner: Connor O'Brien (cc'd) leads our marketplace/onboarding work across AWS/Azure/GCP.
- PO routing: our preferred flow for marketplace purchases is to accept PO + private offer on AWS (we can accept a PO number and invoice via Marketplace), for Azure we typically accept Marketplace purchase or customer-issued PO routed to finance, and for GCP Marketplace we can accept a direct invoice / PO depending on the buyer setup.

I'll loop in our Sales Ops and Marketplace lead to confirm required fields and next steps. If you can return the completed onboarding form + W9 + bank details, we'll push the seller registration pieces in parallel.

Next step: I'll forward this to Sales Ops for intake and tracking in our procurement playbook.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0182
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: BluePeak onboarding packet — action items and timeline

Forwarding BluePeak procurement request. Key asks: onboarding form, W9, bank details, confirm marketplace owner and PO routing preference. Target: PO in first week of Jan.

Please advise on:
- Whether Sales Ops needs any additional fields for BluePeak's vendor portal (GL codes, commodities codes)
- Which marketplace flows (AWS private offer, Azure Marketplace, GCP) require platform-side setup or legal redlines
- Any pre-approved pricing or quote template for marketplace listing that we should send to them now

Connor — can you own the marketplace onboarding (APN/Seller registration + GCP/ Azure publisher steps)? Laura — can you own vendor intake and finance routing?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

--
Dylan
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: BluePeak onboarding packet — action items and timeline

Thanks for the ping. I'll own finance intake. Summary of planned actions and timeline:

1) Vendor intake packet (today — 11/11): I'll fill out BluePeak's onboarding form, attach Redwood's W9, and request bank routing details from Legal/Finance if not present. Drafts will be saved to the BluePeak folder on Drive (link below).
2) Marketplace registration (Connor — by 11/20): Connor to confirm our seller IDs and whether any engineering integration (SaaS contract or metering) is required for their procurement flow.
3) Contracting (legal redlines): If BluePeak expects a custom Master Services Agreement or PO terms that differ from our standard marketplace terms, we should triage via Legal. Laura to flag any commercial exceptions.
4) PO routing (by 12/10): We'll confirm whether BluePeak will issue a Marketplace private offer (AWS) or a direct PO. Finance will set up the vendor code and remittance instructions for purchase orders.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/bluepeak-onboarding-2026
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/RED-78910

Attachments I'll upload after I populate their form: Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_Bank_Instructions.xlsx, Redwood_Marketplace_Checklist.xlsx

Laura Bennett
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Luis Sanchez <luis.sanchez@bluepeak.com>, vendor-ops@bluepeak.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding for 2027 procurement cycle - Redwood Inference

Dylan / Laura / Connor,

Thanks — attached are the completed onboarding form, W9, and bank details. We've also included the expected PO template and BluePeak's standard marketplace terms (see attachments). Please confirm receipt and whether there's anything missing.

We prefer the AWS private offer route for the majority of purchases; Azure Marketplace is optional depending on the business case, and GCP purchases will likely be invoiced. BluePeak will issue an initial PO (estimate) in early January and a formal PO once seller registration is complete.

DocuSign link for initial PO placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABCDEF-BluePeak-PO

Regards,

Maria — got everything, thank you. Confirming receipt of: BluePeak_Onboarding_Form_Filled.pdf, W9_BluePeak.pdf, Vendor_Bank_Details.xlsx and the DocuSign PO link.

Immediate next steps on our side:
- Laura will create a vendor code and route the bank details to Finance for ACH setup (expected completion by 12/10).
- Connor will confirm seller IDs and initiate AWS Private Offer setup (target: 11/27 for registration pieces, 12/15 for private offer enabling).
- I'll prepare a short procurement playbook (one page) that outlines PO vs Marketplace purchase flows, typical lead times, and remittance instructions for BluePeak's Sourcing team.

If BluePeak can provision a sample PO and indicate the GL code they will use, that will help speed invoice matching. Otherwise we'll follow up for the formal PO in early January.

I'll keep you posted and we can schedule a 30-min checklist call next week if you prefer.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
